thread:
leo: Hey folks, first day — running Ubuntu 22.04 on a ThinkPad. Pulled WireGuard profile from the portal (split-tunnel). I can ping internal IPs (10.0.5.12) but visiting https://git.redwood.internal/ in Chrome gives "ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR". curl shows TLS handshake fail. Anyone seen this with split tunnel setups?
anya: welcome! :wave: common culprits: internal DNS resolving to private IP but certs signed by internal CA not trusted by your OS/browser. Does curl -v show certificate details?
leo: curl output:
```
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2)
* SSL: certificate signed by unknown authority
```
so yeah maybe CA.
marta: two things to check: 1) are you getting the internal DNS server via WG? `resolvectl status` should list our 172.16.0.10 resolver for the wg interface. 2) do you have the company root CA installed under /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ and run `sudo update-ca-certificates`? For Chrome/Chromium you might need to import into the OS trust store too.
leo: resolvectl shows no 172.16.0.10, only 1.1.1.1 from systemd-resolved. ping to 10.0.5.12 still works though.
infra-bot: Policy check: user leo missing tag 'internal-dns' and 'internal-ca'. Run `infra request-access --tag internal-dns,internal-ca` or contact infra to add tags.
ops-bot: @marta FYI onboarding job left out CA provisioning for leo. Can you patch and push updated profile?
marta: yep grabbing his user id. I'll add tags and push a new WireGuard config that includes DNS and routes. In the meantime you can test by adding our CA locally:
```
sudo curl -o /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/redwood-internal.crt https://intranet.redwood.certs/redwood-internal.crt
sudo update-ca-certificates
# restart chrome: `pkill -f chrome`
```
leo: added cert and restarted chrome — git UI loads! Thanks. Also noted that systemd-resolved cache had stale records. `sudo systemd-resolve --flush-caches` helped.
anya: nice :tada: for future folks, if your client shows only public DNS after WG connect, check both tags and the "push DNS" toggle in the portal.
leo: awesome, great help everyone — tagging infra if any follow-ups. :pray:
